NGO & Public Trust Registrations

Formation, registration and continuing compliance support for charitable trusts, societies and nonprofit organisations under the current regulatory framework.

Scope of services

01Formation and structuring of charitable trusts, societies and Section 8 companies
02Registration and approval advisory under Sections 332 and 354 of the Income-tax Act, 2025
03Provisional and regular applications through Forms 104 and 105
04Eligibility review for five- or ten-year registration under Section 332(5)
05Donor reporting and certificates through Forms 113 and 114
06CSR-1 registration for eligible implementing agencies
07Annual accounts, statutory audits and continuing compliance
08FCRA registration and compliance advisory, where applicable

Our approach

We coordinate entity formation, income-tax registration, donor reporting and continuing compliance around the organisation’s objects, activities and funding model. Registration periods and filing requirements depend on the organisation’s eligibility and circumstances.

Regulatory references are current to October 2026 and may change through legislation, rules, notifications or portal updates. Applicability depends on the facts and should be confirmed for each engagement.

Can this service be combined with accounting or audit support?

Yes. The firm can coordinate related accounting, tax, assurance and advisory work, subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.

Common questions.

Does PSB Associates support NGO and public trust registration?

P S B & Associates LLP provides formation, registration and continuing compliance advisory for charitable trusts, societies and nonprofit organisations, including Section 8 companies.

What nonprofit compliance services does PSB provide?

The firm supports income tax registration and approval applications, donor reporting, CSR-1 registration, annual accounts, audits and continuing compliance. FCRA advisory is available where applicable. Requirements depend on the organisation and its activities.

How do I enquire about trust or NGO registration?

Share the entity type, objects, activities and whether the organisation is new or already registered. The team can discuss formation, applications and continuing compliance relevant to your organisation.
